userCorrection.faceAngle: 최신 첨부의 얼굴 각도 고정. 고개를 돌리지 않고 눈동자만 사격 방향으로.
userCorrection.hair: 어깨 아래로 이어지는 자연스러운 검은 장발
userCorrection.skill: 일제난사: 양손 우지 난사와 스코프 표적 집중 타격

generator.atlasAccess: 원본 시트를 Pixi Texture 사각형으로 읽음. 재압축·배경 제거·워핑 없음.

latestRevision.request: 일제난사와 광역기 사격 모두 휘는 탄도를 없애고 강렬한 직선 사격으로 수정

straightShots.trajectory: 총구와 명중점을 잇는 직선. 곡선 보간·낙차 없음.
straightShots.lighting: 짧은 예광탄의 백색 중심 + 얇은 금빛 광원, 8프레임 총구 섬광, 명중 파열과 직선 파편
straightShots.contact: 비행 0.055초 후 탄환 도착점과 같은 좌표에서 타격 시작

latestRevision.auraRegistration: 12프레임 실제 원 중심을 고정 좌표에 정렬한 뒤 제자리 회전 / 원본 픽셀 보존
latestRevision.outline: 포즈별 알파를 보존한 흰색 실루엣 8방향 외곽 + 이중 블룸
latestRevision.areaSkill: 양자 탄도 폭쇄: 적 5명 포착 → 쌍우지 직선 사격·좌표 지정 → 상공 미사일 강하 → 적 몸통 높이 직격 대폭발 → 5명 연쇄 미사일 명중
latestRevision.impactAnchor: 적 몸통 좌표 범위의 중심. 상단 잘림 방지는 크기에만 적용하며 폭발 위치를 아래로 이동시키지 않음.
latestRevision.missileTipAnchor: 원본 미사일 전방 끝 (1,0.5), 아래 방향 90도 회전. 탄두와 폭발이 동일한 적 좌표 사용.

superseded.battle: 기존 짧은 머리·측면 얼굴 이미지와 가장자리 여백 보정 전 시트는 이력으로만 보존.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean V3 full-body standing battleSprite, one character, native 1024x1536 RGBA PNG with genuine transparent background.
Image 1 is the final current character DESIGN and FACE ANGLE reference. Image 2 only shows convenient isolated full-body framing; it is an older hairstyle and must not override image 1.
Reproduce the character in image 1 as a clean transparent battleSprite. Keep EXACTLY his three-quarter head angle (do not turn into side profile), handsome adult face, same black mask and peaked cap. The EYES look SCREEN RIGHT toward his guns' firing direction without changing the head angle. Retain his new shoulder-length flowing black hair, long back strands behind shoulders with continuous natural flow, no plate-like hair or sharp tiers.
Same black/silver long uniform, silver shoulder cord, black trousers and boots, natural slim adult proportions. 대두 금지 / 자연스러운 성인 비율 / 원화 체형 유지. Full body standing with both boots planted, same confident stance, arms extended forward to screen RIGHT holding TWO black/silver UZI submachine guns at staggered chest heights. Both guns point toward the same enemy. The entire two weapons and hands/grips must be clearly separated and visible. One UZI per hand, box receivers, short barrels, straight magazine through each grip. Each whole gun is a rigid object with straight aligned receiver-barrel-muzzle axis, no bends, no sagging handguard or distorted top rails. Do not add a rifle or physical scope.
REMOVE background, scope aura, smoke wisps, projectile aura, muzzle flashes and floating shell cases. This is the clean body layer for animation; all effects will be separate. Keep attractive silver rim-light on the black clothes as part of the artwork, without a thick halo outline. Do not add an opaque black/gray gradient.
Transparent canvas, no floor, no cast shadow. Full character and both weapons fitted inside with at least 60 pixels of completely empty transparent margin on every edge, including hair, coat tips, boots and gun muzzles. Native 1024x1536 portrait, ONE character, no contact sheet, no text, no frame.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original continuous VFX animation atlas for a premium SSS limited military gunner's area skill, named Quantum Ballistic Cataclysm / 양자 탄도 폭쇄.
Primary request: A spectacular silver-white quantum bomb detonation made from condensed bullet energy, evolving into a towering white-hot blast with a black pressure shell, horizontal shockwave, torn lightning, flying ballistic fragments and finally rolling charcoal vapor. The explosion has weight and readable mass, exquisitely painted anime game VFX, not a flat vector icon.
Composition: One square PNG sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, 16 chronological animation frames read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each frame has the SAME camera and SAME fixed detonation center at 50% width, 57% height of its cell. Truly transparent background. Keep every effect and every glow at least 9% of the cell width away from all four cell boundaries. No cell dividers, labels, numbers or text. No character, guns, environment, UI or checkerboard.
Sequence: frames 1-3 tiny intense silver compression star within contracting charcoal bullet vortex; frame 4 piercing white ignition with black lens; frames 5-6 explosive white sphere erupts with sharp black pressure envelope and horizontal shockwave; frames 7-9 enormous multilayer luminous atomic-like cloud crown with a short energy stem, black smoke filigree and jagged silver rays; frames 10-12 cloud rolls upward and fractures into dense charcoal-and-silver turbulent lobes with showering fragments; frames 13-16 thinning vapor wisps and dying sparks gradually disappear. Geometry, material flow, shock front and particle arrangement must evolve in every frame, not copies resized or rotated. The widest blast fits fully inside its own cell with 9% transparent padding; all small early and late frames stay registered at exactly the same detonation point. White and gray highlights, deep graphite smoke, subtle warm metallic bullet flecks only; no rainbow, purple or blue color scheme.
Constraints: The alpha channel must genuinely be transparent between particles and outside the effect, no black background rectangle. Keep each frame completely separate from adjacent cells. Native detailed raster VFX suitable for compositing over a dark battlefield. No weapons or human victims, only the fantasy blast effect.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PROJECT V premium character sourceArt, single full-length standing portrait, native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, exact 2:3.
Input images: image 1 is the USER'S CHARACTER DESIGN reference (small pixel-art long-uniform officer). Image 2 is ONLY painterly 2D rendering quality and material quality reference. Image 3 is ONLY male facial refinement and painterly quality reference. Do not copy image 2 or 3's character, outfit, weapons, pose, or palette.
Primary request: reimagine the adult male officer from image 1 in a BLACK long uniform, holding one recognizable UZI submachine gun in EACH hand, firing both simultaneously while STANDING. A black face mask covers nose, mouth and jaw. Preserve the reference's peaked officer cap, slim upright full-length figure, calf-length split uniform coat, shoulder epaulettes, belt, fitted trousers and boots, redesigned coherently in black and graphite with restrained silver tailoring. A small amount of dark hair flows naturally from under the cap.
Pose: both boots firmly planted, upright standing firing stance with modest shoulder-width stagger, body in a 3/4 view toward screen right, face visible in three-quarter view. Both arms aim diagonally forward to the same offscreen enemy at screen right; neither gun points toward the viewer. The nearer gun sits at lower chest height, the farther one slightly higher so BOTH complete weapons and BOTH grips are clearly visible and separated. Do not splay the guns in opposite directions. Both UZIs have simultaneous modest white-hot pale warm muzzle flashes and a few visible ejected cases.
Weapon design: exactly TWO compact UZI SMGs, recognizable box-shaped straight receivers, short straight barrels, top sights and straight magazines entering through the pistol grips. Tasteful coordinated black-and-silver fantasy metal skin across each whole gun, retaining recognizable UZI geometry. No rifles, no pistols, no scopes, no giant magazines. Each gun is ONE RIGID SOLID: receiver, barrel and muzzle share one unbroken straight bore axis. No sagging or bent fore-end, no warped receiver, no disconnected parts. Fit the hand and wrist to the correct pistol grip.
Aura: luminous CHARCOAL BLACK with bright SILVER-GRAY edges, a few elegant rising smoky wisps around the shoulders, sides and boots; bright dark energy, readable against both figure and environment. No purple, no blue, no orange or colored magical aura. Keep the face, hands, weapons and boots unobscured. Avoid large rings and wings.
Style: beautiful high-end Korean/Japanese collectible RPG semi-real painterly 2D splash illustration, crisp handsome eyes above the mask, clean refined materials, soft realistic cloth folds, natural adult anatomy. NOT photographic, NOT 3D render, NOT pixel art, NOT chibi. Natural connected strands of hair, no rigid hair plates or tiered bands. Restrained uniform details, coherent black leather, black tailored cloth and gunmetal.
Backdrop: subdued misty graphite military courtyard at night, distant restrained stone and iron architecture, low-contrast charcoal and silver fog, no extra people. Silver aura provides the main rim light. Full character dominates frame but all cap, coat tails, two full guns, flashes and both boots fit inside image with adequate margin. Standing, no running, kneeling, jumping or floating.
No written text, labels, numbers, insignia text, rank, logo, watermark, card frame, split panels or UI. Deliver ONE finished full-body portrait.
